sloka: जातमिष्टमपत्यं मे त्वमद्यानुपमं भुवि ।दत्तमिष्टमधीतं च मया पुरुषसत्तम ॥२-४-१३॥
transliteration: jātamiṣṭamapatyaṁ me tvamadyānupamaṁ bhuvi ।dattamiṣṭamadhītaṁ ca mayā puruṣasattama ॥2-4-13॥

translations.english: O best of men I have obtained now a progeny of my liking in you and you have no equal on earth. I have given gifts, performed rituals and also studied (the Vedas) .
translations.hindi: चह पापिन क्रोध में जली-भुनी ( शयनागार में जा कर) सोती | हुई कैकेयी (को जगा कर उस) से बोली
